csv_project_name: CMAR for New Cherokee Museum Collection Facility
csv_scope_of_work: The EBCI is requesting statements of qualifications from construction management firms or teams of firms for the purpose of selecting a Construction Manager at Risk (CMR). The CMR will work alongside the design team during the development phase of the project and will be fully responsible for construction of the facilities once a final design is complete. The project is a two and a half story structure containing approximately 35,000 square feet that will house archeological collections, laboratories, conservations labs and other resources to help the Eastern Band of Cherokee to preserve cultural resources.

title: CMAR for New Cherokee Museum Collection Facility
short_description: Construction manager at risk sought for a new museum collection and laboratory facility.
project_scope: New two-and-a-half-story building of approximately 35,000 square feet for the Eastern Band of Cherokee Indians, intended to house archaeological collections, laboratories, conservation labs, and related resources for preservation of cultural resources.
services: Construction Manager at Risk (CMAR) services; preconstruction collaboration with the design team during project development and full responsibility for construction after completion of final design.
relevance_explanation:
- Building project with moderate size (about 35,000 sq ft) and cultural use, which is somewhat relevant to sbp.
- However, the procurement is primarily for CMAR/construction management rather than structural design or specialist engineering.
- No indication of long spans, special structural systems, lightweight construction, or innovative engineering features.
- Limited direct entry opportunity for sbp unless through contractor collaboration during design development.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. Available basis for a rough estimate: new 35,000 sq ft specialized museum collection/storage and laboratory building in North Carolina, two-and-a-half stories, including conservation labs and archival functions; such facilities can vary widely depending on environmental control and collection requirements.
fee_explanation: No design fee or engineering fee is stated in the source. The notice is for CMAR services, not a direct structural engineering appointment.
references_qualifications: Statements of qualifications requested from construction management firms or teams of firms for selection of a Construction Manager at Risk; no detailed reference thresholds are stated in the source excerpt.
award_criteria: Selection based on statements of qualifications for CMAR services; detailed award criteria and weighting are not stated in the source excerpt.
contracting_authority: Eastern Band of Cherokee Indians, Cherokee, NC, USA. Contact: Becky Bowe. Phone: 828-359-6702. Email: rebebowe@ebci-nsn.gov.
notes: Target market listed as General Building. Pre-submittal meeting: 05/21/2026 10:00 AM EDT at 589 Tsali Blvd, Cherokee, NC 28719, USA; attendance recommended. Solicitation documents available by contact. Disciplines requested: Design Build/Developer, Construction/Project Management.
